scope: risk-increasing portfolio BUY admission in PAPER and LIVE
partial_fill_rule: filled quantity is in marked position; only remaining BUY quantity is committed
duplicate_rule: same broker/local client_order_id counts once at conservative larger notional
deferred_buy: not committed while dependent SELL is pending; replan and gate at actual submission
risk_reducing_sell: permitted independently of BUY gross/cash headroom
passive_gross_drift: no forced liquidation and no tolerance invented
